cases.name: Terry A. Dolowy
cases.about: She was a senior at the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse, studying finance and worked full time as a bar manager at an upscale restaurant in La Crosse, WI, known as Piggy’s.
cases.narrative: On 2/18/1985, her body was found about six miles south of La Crosse, burning in a culvert. She had been decapitated. Her head has never been located.
